title: The whitelist confirmation's "See how Tracy works" line is a whole link to /how-it-works/, not cut after "tracy." by the autolink guard
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/mail-footer-terms.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/whitelist-confirmation-i18n.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the '# fail' line and the result of each test named in run.tests.
expect: The confirmation HTML holds 'See how Tracy works: https://tracy.ai/how-it-works/', with no zero-width joiner inside the address; the text part keeps 'See how Tracy works: https://tracy.ai/how-it-works/'; the visitor's website stays unlinkable (example.‌com).
evidence: Sarah, 06/10/2026, Gmail on a phone: in the confirmation from plugin 1.1.2 only 'https://tracy.' was a link; the line was a text paragraph run through unlinkedHtml.
fence: The pure mail renderer; no mail client.

tests: 3: the confirmation links "See how Tracy works" whole
the English mail kept its words
every sentence of the mail is a catalogue key, in every language
